name: Pyrenees

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Shiraz, Chardonnay and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in the Western Victoria area, around the Pyrenees ranges and the town of Avoca, at the southern end of the Great Dividing Range. Shiraz is 36 percent of plantings, followed by Chardonnay and Cabernet Sauvignon.
